layouts.name: CBitmapSource_GetNineGridMargins
layouts.notes: CBitmapSource::Create stores the caller-supplied MARGINS at +0x20, while CAtlasedImage::AppendAtlasNineGrid and CDrawNineGridInstruction::Initialize independently read a second MARGINS at +0x30. Verified on uDWM 17763.719, 19041.3758, 22000.194, and 22621.6630. ButtonGlowHandler writes the theme-atlas destination margins here for the native nine-grid path; its separate size calculation uses OpenGlass-owned storage.
